title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bullied, overweight Yuya Tenjo is cast out by his family and inherits his late grandfather's house, which holds a door to the fantasy world of Argena. Leveling up there transforms his body and abilities, and he enrolls at an elite academy while protecting Princess Lexia, the former assassin Luna and his classmate Kaori. A power-fantasy isekai adapted from Miku's light novels.
life_message: Kindness and humility matter more than power, though power lets you protect those you care about.
